source: NACA ACR L4L07 / WR L-177 (Vogeley 1944), NTRS 19930093302, figure 1 (blade-form curves), page 16 rendered at 300 dpi by naca-archive's debug-figs workflow. Curves traced with digitize_track.py (fig1_l177_trace_config.json); calibration from the axis labels: r/R 0 at x=845 px, 1.0 at 1830 px; zero line y=2281 px, 4 deg = 0.1 h/b = 0.02 b/D per 194.8 px. Check: theta-beta at 0.75R reads -0.07 deg (0 by definition).
propeller: Curtiss No. 714-1C2-12, four blades, Clark Y sections, diameter 12 ft 2 in, gear ratio 2:1, P&W R-2800-21, Republic P-47C; tested with standard production cooling cuffs
notes: Bare-propeller (solid) curves. The cooling cuffs (dashed, r/R < 0.37) change the root shape; not modeled.
r/R <= 0.30: twist and h/b read by eye (the tracer starts at 0.31 where the curves crowd); h/b there is only roughly known (0.6-0.7), and matters little.
The b/D curve ends at r/R = 0.915; the model rounds the tip (see model.py).
